name: What is the advantage of using a general remodeling contractor for countertop upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What is the advantage of using a general remodeling contractor for countertop upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing countertops involves more than just stone fabrication; it impacts plumbing lines, wall surfaces, and base framing. While countertop companies often drop the stone in place, they rarely handle plumbing reconnections, electrical adjustments for cooktops, or drywall repair. A full-scope residential remodeling contractor manages the entire workflow: disconnecting lines, reinforcing cabinetry, fabricating and securing slabs, coordinating plumbing and electrical trades, and finishing the job with professional drywall and tile backsplashes. This ensures a seamless turnaround through a single point of contact.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general remodeling contractor handles the complete project, coordinating stone installation, cabinet adjustments, plumbing reconnections, and matching tile backsplash work.
